stories.title: Nvidia Revenue Doubles to $100bn
stories.details: Nvidia reported a doubling in quarterly revenue to nearly $100bn, with CEO Jensen Huang declaring a 'golden age' for the AI industry. The results exceeded Wall Street forecasts and helped revive confidence in the tech sector following recent market volatility.

stories.title: Meta Settles Teen Addiction Lawsuit
stories.details: Meta has agreed to pay up to $17.1 billion to settle a lawsuit from 51 US states alleging its platforms were designed to be addictive to children. The settlement includes mandatory safety measures, such as default daily time limits and the removal of cosmetic surgery filters for minors.

stories.title: Bill Gates Proposes 'Human Reserved' Jobs
stories.details: Bill Gates has suggested that society should deliberately protect certain occupations, such as childcare and jury service, for humans even as AI capabilities advance. He proposed taxing AI tokens and robots to fund this transition for workers who cannot retrain.

stories.title: Meta's AI Replacement Plan Fails
stories.details: Internal documents revealed that Mark Zuckerberg's 'Project OT,' which aimed to replace thousands of Meta employees with AI, collapsed. The initiative resulted in increased coding errors and system outages, forcing staff to spend the majority of their time fixing AI-generated issues.

stories.title: Amazon Shuts Down Mechanical Turk
stories.details: Amazon is permanently closing its 21-year-old crowdsourcing marketplace, Mechanical Turk, on September 30, 2026. The platform, which once hosted 500,000 workers, struggled to compete with modern AI-driven alternatives and faced issues with workers using AI to complete tasks.

stories.title: AI-Assisted Brain Surgery in London
stories.details: Neurosurgeons in London have successfully performed the first AI-assisted operation to remove a brain tumour. This milestone highlights the growing integration of advanced technology in high-stakes medical procedures.

stories.title: Devastating Floods in Nepal and Tibet
stories.details: Flash floods and mudslides along the Nepal-Tibet border have killed at least 160 people, with hundreds more missing. The disaster destroyed critical infrastructure, including roads and bridges, trapping numerous tourists in the Himalayan region.

stories.title: Foreign Nationals Among Missing
stories.details: Authorities report that hundreds of foreign nationals, including at least 33 Britons and over 100 Indians on a Hindu pilgrimage, are among those missing. Search and rescue operations are ongoing as officials warn the death toll is likely to rise.

stories.title: Uncertain Cause of Himalayan Disaster
stories.details: While initial reports suggested a glacier collapse, researchers now believe the flooding was triggered by an avalanche, potentially caused by an earthquake. Experts are investigating how debris may have dammed the Bhote Koshi river, leading to the sudden, catastrophic release of water.

stories.title: Burnham Drops Political Funding Cap
stories.details: Andy Burnham has withdrawn his support for a proposed cap on political funding aimed at curbing the influence of mega-donors. The move has sparked debate within the Labour party regarding the future of political finance reform.

stories.title: Energy Bill Crisis for Households
stories.details: Households in Great Britain face a potential £7bn debt to energy suppliers by the end of the year. Andy Burnham is reportedly considering using the October budget to implement measures to lower energy bills as costs continue to rise.

stories.title: Missing Children from Asylum Hotels
stories.details: Forty children who were reported missing from UK asylum hotels remain unaccounted for. The ongoing issue highlights significant concerns regarding the safety and management of minors within the asylum system.

stories.title: UK Shell Company Money Laundering
stories.details: Reports indicate that up to £464m has been moved through more than 3,000 high street shell companies in the UK. The scale of the activity has raised alarms about the effectiveness of current transparency and anti-money laundering measures.

stories.title: Trump Announces 50% Tariff on Canadian Goods
stories.details: President Trump has announced a new 50% tariff on Canadian cars, trucks, and steel. The move is expected to significantly impact cross-border trade and has raised concerns about a potential trade war.

stories.title: US Designates Palestine Action as Terrorist Group
stories.details: The United States has officially designated Palestine Action as a global terrorist organization. The move freezes any assets the group holds in the US and prohibits its supporters from entering the country.

stories.title: SpaceX to Build $100B Louisiana Spaceport
stories.details: SpaceX plans to construct 'Starbase Louisiana,' a massive $100 billion spaceport on the Gulf Coast. The project, which aims to support thousands of missions annually, has faced pushback from conservation groups concerned about the impact on local wetlands and wildlife.
